basic_info.description: Experience quintessential San Francisco living in this beautiful two-level, 3-bedroom, 2-bath condominium, nestled in the heart of North Beach with stunning views of the Golden Gate Bridge. Bathed in natural light, the spacious living room features expansive bay windows, beautiful hardwood floors, and a cozy gas fireplace framed by elegant built-ins. The formal dining room flows seamlessly into a newly updated, eat-in kitchen with sleek quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances. Two inviting bedrooms and a full bath complete the first level, ideal for daily living and entertaining. Upstairs, the primary suite is a serene retreat with a generous walk-in closet, in-unit laundry, and a luxurious en-suite bath. Step out onto your private deck and savor panoramic views from the Golden Gate Bridge to Alcatraz and Lombard Street. With a deeded two-car garage and extra storage, this home combines practicality with elegance. Just steps away from North Beach's vibrant shops, celebrated restaurants, and scenic parks, and boasting a Walk Score of 99, this residence is a perfect blend of city energy and sophisticated comfort.
